T: Are you not entertained. Are you not fed.
D: A betrayed Roman general fights his way through the arena to take revenge on the emperor.
P: Serve the mains when Maximus walks into the Colosseum.
S: Strength and honour bread and olives
Warm olives with orange peel, fennel seed and garlic, with torn rustic bread

Rustic loaf torn up, with olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel, fennel seeds and garlic, and a bowl of good olive oil with salt. Warm 300g mixed olives gently in 3 tbsp olive oil with strips of orange peel, 1 tsp fennel seeds and 2 sliced garlic cloves for 5 minutes. Tear a rustic loaf into chunks. Serve with the olives and a bowl of olive oil with salt for dipping.
Baked figs with goat's cheese, honey, toasted walnuts and thyme
Ripe figs halved, topped with a little goat's cheese, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, drizzled with honey and toasted walnuts.
Maximus running his hand through the wheat

Thin wholemeal crackers baked crisp with olive oil, sea salt and rosemary, with whipped lemon ricotta and a pool of honey and chilli oil. Mix 200g wholemeal flour, 60ml olive oil, 1 tsp salt and 90ml water into a firm dough. Roll very thin, cut into long strips, brush with oil and scatter with rosemary and sea salt. Bake at 180C for 12 to 15 minutes until crisp. Beat 250g ricotta with lemon zest and salt. Swirl 1 tbsp honey with 1 tbsp chilli oil over the ricotta.
M: Lamb leg studded with garlic, rosemary and anchovy, with tomato chickpeas
Lamb leg studded with garlic, rosemary and anchovy, roasted at 180C to 58C, rested, carved, with chickpeas braised with tomato and greens.
Proximo's sausage, barley and lentil stew

Thick and smoky stew of pork sausage, pearl barley and lentils with onion, carrot, tomato and rosemary, finished with olive oil and parmesan. Brown 500g thick pork sausages cut into chunks. Soften an onion, 2 carrots and 2 garlic cloves in the same pot. Add 100g pearl barley, 150g brown lentils, 400g crushed tomatoes, 1.2L chicken stock and rosemary. Simmer 50 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick. Finish with a drizzle of olive oil, grated parmesan and crusty bread.
W: Ricotta cakes baked on bay leaves, drizzled with warm honey and poppy seeds
Ricotta, flour and egg cakes baked on bay leaves at 200C for 30 minutes, soaked in warm honey, poppy seeds on top.
K: Are you not entertained spiced honey wine
Warm red wine with honey, pepper, bay, saffron and orange peel

Roman-style spiced wine warmed with honey, black pepper, bay, saffron and orange peel, strained into cups and served warm. Pour a 750ml bottle of red wine into a pot with 3 tbsp honey, half a tsp black peppercorns, 2 bay leaves, a pinch of saffron and strips of orange peel. Warm gently for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into cups and serve warm.

Stud the lamb with garlic, rosemary and anchovies.
Roast at 180C until 58C inside, about 90 minutes.
Rest the lamb for 20 minutes. Meanwhile simmer the chickpeas with the tomatoes, then stir through the spinach.
Carve and serve with the chickpeas.
Halve the eggplants lengthways, score the flesh deeply and stud the cuts with garlic, rosemary and capers. Brush with the oil and season with salt.
Roast at 200C until soft and collapsing.
Meanwhile simmer the chickpeas with the tomatoes, then stir through the spinach.
Serve the eggplant on the chickpeas with the feta crumbled over.

s.n: Strength and honour bread and olives
s.note: Warm olives with orange peel, fennel seed and garlic, with torn rustic bread
s.how: Warm 300g mixed olives gently in 3 tbsp olive oil with strips of orange peel, 1 tsp fennel seeds and 2 sliced garlic cloves for 5 minutes. Tear a rustic loaf into chunks. Serve with the olives and a bowl of olive oil with salt for dipping.

s.note: Baked figs with goat's cheese, honey, toasted walnuts and thyme
s.how: Halve 8 ripe figs and put a small spoon of goat's cheese on each, using 120g in total. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Drizzle with honey, scatter with 60g toasted walnuts and a few thyme leaves and serve warm.

m.note: Lamb leg studded with garlic, rosemary and anchovy, with tomato chickpeas
m.how: Stud a 2kg lamb leg with slivers of 4 garlic cloves, rosemary and 4 anchovies. Roast at 180C to 58C inside, about 90 minutes, and rest 20 minutes. Simmer 2 tins chickpeas with a tin of tomatoes and a handful of greens. Carve and serve.

w.note: Ricotta cakes baked on bay leaves, drizzled with warm honey and poppy seeds
w.how: Mix 250g ricotta, 100g flour and 1 egg into a soft dough. Shape into 8 small rounds, put each on a bay leaf and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Pour over 4 tbsp warmed honey and sprinkle with poppy seeds.

d.note: Warm red wine with honey, pepper, bay, saffron and orange peel
d.how: Pour a 750ml bottle of red wine into a pot with 3 tbsp honey, half a tsp black peppercorns, 2 bay leaves, a pinch of saffron and strips of orange peel. Warm gently for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into cups and serve warm.
